metadata.description: ZenHive Claude Code plugins — harness orchestration, workflow/roadmap methodology, and per-language tooling for ZenHive's own packages, each plugin independently toggleable per repo

plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: Language-agnostic orchestration surface for the harness OTP engine — drive the implement → review → land loop (rmap tasks, verified runs, cross-family grading) from any consuming repo. Skills: harness-driver (API/MCP contract), harness-workflow (the loop). Stale-base guard hook.

plugins.name: workflow
plugins.description: Language-agnostic workflow and roadmap methodology — rmap substrate, D/B/U prioritization, task-as-prompt authoring, pickup / plan-and-file modes, worktree isolation, upstream contributions, layered Solidity/EVM verification. Skills: rmap, task-writing, roadmap-planning, task-driver, git-worktrees, upstream-pr-workflow, onchain-verification. Skills only.

plugins.name: elixir
plugins.description: Elixir/OTP development support — four mechanic hooks (post-edit format/compile/matching test, pre-commit format/compile/unused-deps gate, destructive-command block, test.json/dialyzer.json rewrites) plus skills for ZenHive's own Hex packages and conventions. Generic Elixir/Phoenix knowledge is phxagents' job.

plugins.name: elixir-volt
plugins.description: JS-on-BEAM stack support — the Volt/Phoenix client-side toolchain and its npm hygiene. Skills: elixir-volt, oxc, quickbeam, popcorn, npm-ci-verify, npm-dep-analysis, npm-security-audit. Skills only, no hooks.

plugins.name: tools
plugins.description: Personal/utility CLI-usage reference skills — not tied to a development process or a specific language. Skills: himalaya, gloomberb.

plugins.name: dep-audit
plugins.description: Ecosystem-detecting dependency-advisory nag — one shared SessionStart hook that checks a repo's pinned deps (Hex/mix.lock, Rust/Cargo.toml under native/, npm/package.json or npm_ex/npm.lock) for known advisories. Watermark-gated, non-blocking, silent when clean or when tooling is absent.
